blocks.text: Reigning Miss Universe Fatima Bosch has nothing but praise for Philippine delegate Bea Millan-Windorski, whom she fondly described as a “princess.” Bosch showered the Filipino-American beauty queen with compliments, as seen in the video shared by Filipino pageant content creator Adam Genato on Instagram on Wednesday, Nov. 18. “Your [contestant], Philippines, the pageant this year—she’s so beautiful. Your delegate, she’s like a princess. She’s so sweet,” she said while interacting with the Filipino vlogger. “All the girls this year are so sweet. In my year, too, my friends were amazing,” she added. READ: Bea Millan-Windorski expresses admiration for Miss Universe Fatima […]...
